summary: Re-checks the R-11 production-leg evidence (docs/evidence/osr-r11-prod-2026-09-30.json, bound as binding 17198) against the live public repository for grader card EI-25217064677705606. No new capture was taken: the capture was made against a build of public Papercusp/papercusp-app@3c1ed9a1d7dd, and the public main branch is still that exact commit, so the subject under test has not changed. The captured artifacts are unmodified (13/13 SHA256SUMS lines verify), and re-reading the packet capture confirms exactly one non-loopback outbound connection attempt, which is the deliberate control curl.
